DIGEST_TERMINOLOGY.class: two DIFFERENT identity questions, never to be conflated again

FILE_BYTE_DIGEST.formula: sha256(raw file bytes)[:16] — what t5_artifact.file_digest computes

DIGEST_TERMINOLOGY.rule: neither supersedes the other; they answer different questions. Checking a manifest with file_digest reports a FALSE mismatch, and that is what nearly happened here.
DIGEST_TERMINOLOGY.how_it_surfaced: the cited Manifest V2 digest matched no file until the canonicalisation was identified; a HARD STOP was NOT declared because both manifests reproduced their sealed digests exactly under the convention the seals actually used

PROOF_1_VS_SEALED_CANON69.method: PARTITIONED BY security_key_v1 — an exhaustive disjoint decomposition of the full table; k is a column of every row and both sides partition identically

PROOF_2_VS_CURRENT_A2_SOURCES.method: per feature, two-way EXCEPT ALL on (k, bar_start, value, availability) between the CURRENT A2 family output and the canonical surface
PROOF_2_VS_CURRENT_A2_SOURCES.why_this_proof_is_separate: matching the historical CANON69 alone would still pass if the consolidator had silently read a STALE historical source. This proof binds the output to the CURRENT qualified A2 artifacts.

AVAILABILITY_AUTHORITY.correction_made: the first implementation used a census of the historical CANON69 as the ADMISSIBLE label set. That is wrong: a census is a conformance ORACLE, never an authority.
AVAILABILITY_AUTHORITY.prompted_by: the caller's caution that output census must not become authority for admitting a new label

now.ADMISSIBILITY: authority = the frozen SOURCE-FAMILY CONTRACT, read from each producer
now.REALISATION_CONFORMANCE: oracle = the historical CANON69 census, applied only to a rebuild OF HISTORY

AVAILABILITY_AUTHORITY.the_live_example: pd's contract admits UNAVAILABLE_DEPENDENCY; the sealed PD_12_PRODUCTION records it observed ZERO times, because an EMA is UNAVAILABLE exactly when its bar is contaminated so UNAVAILABLE_CURRENT always fires first. Under the census-as-authority version a legitimate future UNAVAILABLE_DEPENDENCY would have been a violation.
AVAILABILITY_AUTHORITY.cross_feature_comparability: only AVAILABLE_VALID vs NON_VALID is treated as comparable. NON-VALID reason codes are NOT assumed comparable across families anywhere in this layer.
